title: 10-Day Cappadocia to Greek Islands Adventure
metaDescription: Journey from Cappadocia through Pamukkale and Ephesus to Samos, Mykonos and Santorini on a 10-day route linking Turkey with the Greek Islands.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 10-Day Turkey & Greece Tour connects Istanbul with Athens and two of the Cyclades’ best-known islands in a straightforward two-country route. Begin with guided sightseeing in Istanbul before flying to Athens for its classical heritage and historic neighborhoods. The journey then shifts from city stays to island travel, continuing by ferry to Mykonos and Santorini, with time to experience each destination rather than visiting only as a cruise stop.
Travel dates and pacing can be adjusted around your plans. Selected 4-star hotels, daily breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees during guided visits, scheduled flights, ferry tickets, airport and port transfers and planned sightseeing are included.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus cruise and Asia Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, one of the city’s most colorful and lively markets. Continue with a scenic cruise along the Bosphorus, sailing between Europe and Asia while enjoying views of palaces, mosques, and waterfront mansions. Cross the Bosphorus Bridge to Çamlıca Hill for panoramic views over the city, then visit the elegant Beylerbeyi Palace, the former summer residence of Ottoman sultans. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Flight to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Santorini.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Free day in Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a free day at leisure in Santorini to relax on the beaches or explore the charming town of Fira.
Optional boat or bus excursions to the volcano and nearby islands are available. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Mykonos
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel, then transfer to the port in Santorini for your ferry to Mykonos.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Mykonos
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day to explore Mykonos at your own pace. Wander through the charming whitewashed streets of Mykonos Town, discover boutique shops, waterfront cafés, and local restaurants, or relax on one of the island’s beautiful beaches. In the evening, enjoy the lively atmosphere and famous nightlife that Mykonos is known for. Overnight in Mykonos.

itinerary.title: Mykonos to Athens By Ferry
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to the port in Mykonos for your ferry to Athens.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens City Tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a half-day city tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Parthenon, and Acropolis Museum. Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Return to the hotel and enjoy free time at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Turkey and Greece Tour?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Turkey and Greece Tour covers Istanbul, Athens, Santorini, and Mykonos. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Athens' ancient monuments including the Acropolis and Parthenon, and enjoy the beauty of Greece's most famous islands, Santorini and Mykonos. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days and offers an excellent combination of history, culture, and island relaxation.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Turkey and Greece Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from 2,395 euros per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic flights, the international flight between Turkey and Greece, ferry tickets between the Greek islands, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are flights and ferry tickets included in this 10-day itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic flights, the international flight between Turkey and Greece, and ferry transportation between Athens, Mykonos, and Santorini. These travel arrangements help maximize your sightseeing time while ensuring a comfortable and convenient journey.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 9 nights at carefully selected 4-star hotels and boutique accommodations with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near major attractions, city centers, and ferry ports. All airport, hotel, and port transfers are included throughout the tour.

faqs.q: Does the 10-day Turkey and Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours in Istanbul and Athens. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural background, and local expertise while helping you make the most of your travel experience.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience the highlights of both countries without changing destinations too frequently. It combines the rich history of Istanbul and Athens with the stunning island scenery of Santorini and Mykonos.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the 10-day tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through historic districts, archaeological sites, and island towns, including the Acropolis in Athens and the old quarters of Istanbul. Most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: Are Mykonos and Santorini included in the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, both Mykonos and Santorini are included in the itinerary. You will have free time to explore Mykonos' charming streets and vibrant atmosphere, as well as Santorini's famous caldera views, whitewashed villages, and breathtaking sunsets.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Turkey and Greece Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and peace of mind.

faqs.q: Is the 10-Day Turkey and Greece Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules, and can be customized according to your preferences. You can extend your stay in Istanbul, Athens, Mykonos, or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
